stories.title: Anthropic IPO draws orders several times the shares on offer
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports demand is several times the offering as Anthropic seeks up to $90.4 billion; pricing is expected November 18 and Nasdaq trading (ticker ANT) November 19.
stories.why: The biggest AI listing so far, and a read on how the market values AI labs.

stories.title: Anthropic sets IPO range at $70 to $78 a share, about a $1.4 trillion valuation
stories.summary: 825 million Class A shares, plus a $26 billion private sale to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC; run-rate revenue reached $81 billion by end of October.
stories.why: Shows how far AI revenue has scaled and who is funding it.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 at lower prices
stories.summary: Both models cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, down from $10 and $50, with gains in coding, reasoning and vision.
stories.why: Cheaper coding models matter for the AI tools he builds with.

stories.title: Plurai raises $13M seed to test AI agents with simulations
stories.summary: Team8 led the round; the startup builds digital twins of a company's systems to find agent edge cases before production.
stories.why: Agent reliability is exactly the problem in the automation roles he targets.

stories.title: Mercor raises $750M at a $20B valuation
stories.summary: Series D backed by Nvidia, Salesforce and Benchmark, including an undisclosed employee share tender.
stories.why: It supplies expert work to AI labs, the same market as micro1.

stories.title: Fractile raises $720M Series C for AI chips
stories.summary: The British startup, backed by the UK Sovereign AI Fund, is valued above 5 billion pounds and plans to ship its first chips next year.
stories.why: Shows investors still paying heavily for AI inference hardware.

stories.title: Torus raises $500M to put AI compute on spare grid power
stories.summary: Magnetar led the round; Foundry units run 1 to 20 megawatts of inference at existing sites in 12 to 16 weeks.
stories.why: Power is becoming the bottleneck for AI capacity.

stories.title: WayaWaya partners with Choice Bank for AI-powered banking
stories.summary: WayaWaya Banking lets customers open accounts, hold multiple currencies, transfer money and pay bills on a CBK-regulated platform. Published November 6.
stories.why: A Nairobi fintech building with AI, close to his Kwara background.
